kyoto_gion_tempura_koromo.notes: [Tempura · Gion south, rice-flour tempura and eel rice] A Gion tempura counter frying in rice flour and rice oil for a light, crisp coat, with sashimi and hassun in the courses and a clay pot of eel rice to finish. Courses ¥15,730–30,250 including service; weekend lunch; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: A Gion tempura restaurant whose courses are fried by veteran chefs in front of guests (japan-food.guide). Reviewers (2025–2026) describe attentive, smiling staff, careful explanations of each ingredient and a chef who remembers returning guests.

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 party in the upstairs private room called the clay-pot eel rice the highlight.
An August 2025 family was put at ease by the care taken over allergies.
A December 2025 guest on a third visit was remembered by the chef and paired the courses with sake.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園天ぷら ころも、天ぷら、京都市東山区祇園町南側570-8、夜は月・水〜金・祝前日 17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、土日祝は昼11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:30) と夜17:00〜22:00、火曜定休、ランチは基本的に土日祝のみ、当日の夜の予約も空きがあれば可、カード (銀聯も)・QR決済可、電子マネー不可、22席、個室 (2〜10名)、禁煙。japan-food.guide: 米粉と米油で揚げる新しいスタイルの天ぷら、京野菜と旬の魚介、コースはテイスティング15,730円ほか18,150円、21,780円、30,250円 (サービス料10%込み)、名物のうなぎめし。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 米粉の軽い衣、米油、八寸と刺身付きのコース、牡蠣のチーズタルタル、生ハムとチーズの天ぷら、海苔巻きの牡蠣、蟹、白子、土鍋のうなぎめしをひつまぶし風に、おかわりも、アレルギーへの配慮、2階の個室、シェフが顔を覚えている。

kyoto_astarte_karasuma.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 7:30–15:00; closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Counter seats and tables at the back; non-smoking; take-out (Tabelog; June–July 2026). A glass-fronted café behind a small car park, just east of the Sanjo-Muromachi crossing (July 2026). 5 min walk from Karasuma-Oike Stn.
kyoto_astarte_karasuma.notes: [Café · Sanjo-Muromachi, from 7:30] A sleek glass-and-concrete café for an early breakfast: thick ham-and-egg toast with a muffin for ¥100 more, a counter of colourful muffins, seasonal fruit tarts and good coffee or peach Earl Grey. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: ASTARTE COFFEE & PASTRY, a stylish café near Karasuma-Oike that fills up soon after its 7:30 opening, known for muffins and fruit tarts and for kind, attentive staff (2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular, who counts it among favourite Kyoto cafés, found the figs on the fig and maple tart unusually juicy.
An October 2026 sightseer hunting for coffee at 7:30 a.m. puzzled over a muffin costing ¥500 alone but ¥100 with toast.
A March 2026 visitor found it busy straight after the early opening, and paired thick toast with a caramel walnut muffin.

kyoto_nasuoyaji_hanare.gf_detail: Not GF: European-style curry roux and katsu curry; no gluten-free roux mentioned (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_nasuoyaji_hanare.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the curry base is made with minced pork, with beef, pork and chicken toppings (2026 reviews).
kyoto_nasuoyaji_hanare.hours_raw: Daily including holidays 8:00–22:30 (last order 22:00) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 22 seats at the counter and tables; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children welcome; bicycle parking (Tabelog). Queues at peak times (September 2026). A stylish room lined with records, in a former bistro; 5 min walk from Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog; September 2026). Opened 10 April 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_nasuoyaji_hanare.notes: [Curry · Sanjo-Muromachi, 8:00–22:30] The Kyoto offshoot of a veteran Shimokitazawa curry house: rich European-style curry of 20-plus spices and long-cooked onion, with tender beef or the all-in special, in a calm, record-lined room with coffee and desserts. Open daily, from breakfast to late.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: Nasu Oyaji is the oldest curry shop in Shimokitazawa, Tokyo, and HanaRe, opened 10 April 2024, is its first second shop, serving European-style curry arranged its own way, with selected music and coffee. Reviewers in 2026 describe a stylish room in a former bistro, lined with records.
chef_bio.philosophy: Curry you won’t tire of even if you eat it every day (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 Silver Week diner got the last counter seat at 1:30 p.m. for a beef curry simmered until tender, as a queue formed behind.
A September 2026 regular passing on another shop’s daily special warned that the thin-looking plate is more filling than it seems.
A September 2026 diner who remembered the space as a bistro noticed the counter seats had barely changed.

kyoto_sosaku_kappou_ootani.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-led kappo with meat dishes and dashi (Tabelog; 2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sosaku_kappou_ootani.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 16:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); Saturday and Sunday 12:00–23:00; closing days not fixed, often Wednesday (Tabelog). kyoto_sosaku_kappou_ootani.notes: [Creative kappo · Oshikoji-Takakura] A homely ten-seat counter where a young owner-chef cooks seasonal fish with flair — salt-dressed squid, grilled gurnard, hamo — plus a famous potato salad, with some 30 sakes to match. Bib Gourmand per reviewers. Book; often closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: opened 8 October 2021 (Tabelog) and listed as a Michelin Bib Gourmand in the 2023 guide (November 2022 review); a young chef who used to be a carpenter (August 2024) cooks and pours single-handed, with the chef’s wife welcoming guests at a cosy counter where regulars chat (July 2024; August 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal sashimi; potato salad with egg-yolk vinegar.

anecdotes.text: An August 2024 solo diner hunting for fish wandered in and later heard the owner had been a carpenter — and thanked the career change.
A March 2024 guest was steered to eat the squid with salt to bring out its sweetness, with fresh wasabi.
Five old school friends celebrated a promotion over sashimi, crab and grilled guchi in June 2026.

kyoto_bar_towser.vegan_detail: Ask. Whisky, champagne and cocktails; no food or vegan information in the sources (2020–2026 reviews).

From about ¥4,400 (July 2023). Nijo Building 1F, Kawabata-Nijo; opened 24 October 2016 (Tabelog).
kyoto_bar_towser.notes: [Whisky bar · Kawabata-Nijo, late] A quiet eight-seat bar for whisky lovers: tell the master your taste and get thoughtful pours from a big, unusual selection, plus highballs and cocktails, with jazz in the background. Smoking allowed. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: run by a calm, kind master named Fujibayashi (October 2020), who came from K6 (May 2023); opened 24 October 2016 (Tabelog), known for whisky knowledge shared gently and for recommending pours to suit each guest (2023–2025).

anecdotes.text: An October 2020 visitor turned away from another bar ended up here with a Harper highball on a coaster with a black cat.
A November 2022 business party of eight, sent by a bar master in Nagoya, had the whole bar to themselves.
A neighbour who drops in after work let the master choose the whiskies, after starting with champagne (July 2025).

kyoto_karasuma_gojo_jigen.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi and some grilled dishes may suit, but tempura, satsuma-age, ponzu and dashi dishes involve wheat or soy (2026 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_karasuma_gojo_jigen.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, wagyu and dashi-based dishes, though vegetables feature (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_karasuma_gojo_jigen.hours_raw: Tuesday–Saturday and holidays 12:00–21:00, all day; closed Monday and Sunday (not fixed); evenings can be extended to about 22:00 if you call by the day before (Tabelog). Charges: one-drink system; ¥500 otoshi for à la carte only; courses include the seat charge (Tabelog original ワンドリンク制・単品の方のみお通し代500円 コースは席料込み). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). kyoto_karasuma_gojo_jigen.notes: [Day-drinking kappo · Karasuma-Gojo, Japanese only] A signless, polished izakaya open from noon, moved from Shijo-Omiya: lotus-root sesame tofu, homemade satsuma-age, sashimi and kamameshi with fine sake, as a good-value lunch set or à la carte. House rules: Japanese speakers only, two or more, one drink each. Closed Sun–Mon.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: run by 株式会社じげん (NTA invoice register), a long-loved Shijo-Omiya restaurant that moved to Karasuma-Gojo and reopened on 5 March 2026, now serving straight through from noon; a young couple runs it, seats few guests, and keeps no sign outside (April–September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Lotus-root sesame tofu; homemade satsuma-age; kamameshi.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 regular from the Shijo-Omiya days, on a third day-drinking stop, could not choose between the sea bream and seasonal kamameshi — so had both.
A May 2026 guest called the lotus-root sesame tofu possibly the best ever, along with fluffy homemade satsuma-age.
A local in July 2026 heard the owners had moved to avoid foreign tourists and keep no sign out front.

kyoto_warakumi_ishimaru.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish-centred set meals and izakaya dishes — sashimi, grilled fish, eel, mackerel sushi, chicken kara-age (2020–2026 reviews).
kyoto_warakumi_ishimaru.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday and public holidays; hours may change. Lunch is one omakase set only, served within minutes (¥980 in 2020–21, ¥1,200 tax incl. in 2025–26); popular with local office workers and often full; sashimi can sell out late in lunch (August 2024). Reservations taken. 20 seats (about 6 at the counter). Smoking allowed — ashtrays on the tables (2024–2025 reviews). Cards: JCB, AMEX, Diners only (Tabelog); a June 2025 diner found cards not accepted that day — bring cash. Down a small alley 180 m from Gojo Station.
kyoto_warakumi_ishimaru.notes: [Japanese izakaya · Gojo-Karasuma, a couple's alley kitchen] A tidy little alley spot near Gojo Station run by a husband and wife for 20+ years. Lunch is one ¥1,200 omakase tray of fish and small dishes, out in a minute; at night, sashimi, grilled fish and the much-praised saba sushi with sake. Smoking allowed. Closed Sun and holidays.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a small restaurant run by a couple (February 2022; June and October 2025). A February 2025 diner returning after 20 years found "both the chef and the owner still looking the same"; a 2022 reviewer felt the cooking showed thorough training in Japanese cuisine. The couple can seem a little stern at first but are friendly once you talk (June 2025).

anecdotes.text: February 2025: "It had been 20 years since my last visit, and it was so nostalgic to see both the chef and the owner still looking the same."
October 2025: "This saba sushi was absolutely exquisite! The richness of the fish, the curing process, and the balance with the vinegared rice were all perfect."
August 2025: "I had the Omakase Set Meal for JPY 1200, and while I had high expectations, it turned out to be just average."

kyoto_washokudo_sugizen.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: Japanese dishes seasoned with soy sauce and miso, green-tea soba, curry udon, fried ginkgo and a soy-milk pudding with kinako (2018–2025 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_washokudo_sugizen.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-focused Japanese kitchen — sashimi, conger eel, crab, buri daikon, duck, shirasu (2018–2026 reviews).
kyoto_washokudo_sugizen.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–23:30; Sat 17:30–23:30; closed Sunday (open Sunday when Monday is a holiday, then closed that Monday); last orders food 22:00, drinks 22:30. Reservations taken; private hire for up to 20. 34 seats: 20 at tables, a 6-seat terrace box, 8 at the counter; semi-private seating. Non-smoking. Cards; no e-money. Lunch is a daily set shown at the door (¥900, December 2023); dinner à la carte or chef's courses. Stroller-friendly (April 2024). On Nijo-dori west of Teramachi, 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae.
kyoto_washokudo_sugizen.notes: [Japanese dining · Teramachi-Nijo, fish and sake without the formality] A spacious, easygoing Japanese restaurant: a ¥900-ish daily lunch set for city-hall workers, and at night thick sashimi, seasonal fish and well-priced chef's courses at counter or tables. About ¥5,000–8,000 at dinner. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a friendly, approachable owner (February 2024), staff who explain each dish (June 2026) and a lunch crowd of city-hall workers (December 2022). Regulars use it for family celebrations (June 2018).
chef_bio.specialty: Fish-led Japanese dishes and chef's courses; daily lunch set.

anecdotes.text: November 2022: "Starting with 'Fried Ginkgo Nuts,' the second dish was a surprise with 'Shrimp Nigiri and Karasumi Mochi.' Then we had 'Conger Eel,' followed by 'Crab,' delicious 'Sashimi,' and even 'Buri Daikon'."
June 2026: "From the very first dish, I was impressed by the intricate preparations… The rare tuna and the final dish of fresh shirasu rice bowl left me completely satisfied."
December 2023: "All of this for just JPY 900! The portion was a bit on the smaller side, but it's quite affordable for this area."

kyoto_mini_nepal_higashiyama.vegan_detail: Ask. Dal bhat comes in a vegetable version (November 2025), but hot ghee is poured over the rice and dal at the table, and sides include yogurt raita; ask for it without ghee or yogurt.
kyoto_mini_nepal_higashiyama.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00; hours may change. Lunch served on holidays too (February 2025). kyoto_mini_nepal_higashiyama.notes: [Nepalese · Higashiyama-Sanjo, dal bhat with sizzling ghee] A cozy Nepali spot steps from Higashiyama Station: hearty dal bhat sets (vegetable, chicken or mutton) with hot ghee poured on at the table, plus momo, Kaja sets and naan curries. About ¥1,500 with a lassi. Cards not accepted (e-money and QR codes are). Service can be slow when busy.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2025–2026) describe a hidden spot near an intersection on the way to the Kyocera Museum, an exotic interior and a mostly overseas staff with one fluent Japanese speaker. Criticisms: an order mix-up (February 2025), a wait of almost an hour (April 2026) and uneven attention between tables (December 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Dal bhat sets; Kaja set; momo.

anecdotes.text: July 2025: "After the meal was served, a small frying pan filled with bubbling ghee arrived, which was poured over the rice and lentil curry."

April 2026: "The only downside was that it took almost an hour for the food to be served... Maybe it was just bad timing?"

kyoto_aic_akitsushima_kiyomizu.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Sun 10:00–19:00 (L.O. 18:00); Wed–Sat 10:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); irregular closing days posted on Instagram. kyoto_aic_akitsushima_kiyomizu.notes: [Café and tea · Kiyomizu, a garden house below the temple] A calm, beautifully fitted house a few minutes below Kiyomizu-dera, with a garden by a Kyoto gardener, a wall of tea canisters, Japanese rooms downstairs and Western rooms upstairs. Lunch courses from ¥3,500, afternoon tea, or just tea and cake. 10% service charge. Vegetarian options listed.

chef_bio.background: A November 2025 reviewer describes it as a new sister of the clubhouse AIC Akitsushima in Kamigamo, with autumn colours in a garden by a renowned Kyoto gardener, a dry-landscape garden at the back, a tea-sales counter by the entrance, Japanese-style rooms on the 1st floor and Western-style rooms on the 2nd. The Kamigamo clubhouse is a members' club whose restaurant is open to the public (rurubu). That reviewer found the newly opened service a bit awkward but earnest.
chef_bio.specialty: Set lunches; afternoon tea; pot tea.

anecdotes.text: November 2025: "Once you pass through the noren (fabric curtain), the entrance leading to the restaurant feels like stepping into another world. The stunning autumn leaves are a feast for the eyes, crafted by a renowned Kyoto gardener."
November 2025: "It was tender and cooked well, but I noticed a slight meat odor. Perhaps I should have chosen the scallops instead."
August 2026: "Both the tea and cake were delicious. I would have appreciated having something like a napkin, though."

kyoto_paris_honpo_koromonotana.notes: [Yoshoku izakaya · machiya off Sanjo-dori, since 2003] A 12-seat counter in a townhouse near Karasuma-Oike where a chatty owner cooks Western-style plates with a Kyoto touch: carpaccio-style sashimi, thick shumai, lemon cream pasta and, in summer, conger eel every way. chef_bio.background: Open since February 2003 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe a friendly, talkative owner cooking at the counter (June 2026). No operator was found.

Operator: 株式会社京都ホテル, which runs Karasuma Kyoto Hotel and Hotel Okura Kyoto (Mynavi company page; 株式会社京都ホテル press release); Hotel Okura has been its largest shareholder since 2005 (3rd-in.co.jp).
kyoto_orizzonte_karasuma_kyoto_hotel.notes: [Breakfast buffet · Shijo-Karasuma] The 3rd-floor breakfast room of Karasuma Kyoto Hotel, a local Kyoto company's hotel: a Japanese and Western buffet with obanzai and yudofu from 7 am. About ¥2,000–3,000.

roles: Restaurant of Karasuma Kyoto Hotel (operator 株式会社京都ホテル)
chef_bio.background: Opened 24 March 2012 (Tabelog). Karasuma Kyoto Hotel is run by 株式会社京都ホテル, a Kyoto company founded in 1927 that also runs Hotel Okura Kyoto; Hotel Okura has been its largest shareholder since 2005 (Mynavi; 株式会社京都ホテル press release; 3rd-in.co.jp).

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 hotel guest worked through vegetables, eggs and sausages, then fried dishes, kinpira and curry rice, finishing with milk.
A December 2025 guest noted the room is a multipurpose space that becomes the breakfast hall each morning, with obanzai and yudofu.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: からすま京都ホテル オリゾンテ、ビュッフェ、下京区 からすま京都ホテル3F、地下鉄四条駅6番出口、毎日 7:00〜10:00、カード可、140席、禁煙、2012年3月24日オープン。運営は株式会社京都ホテル (ホテルオークラ京都とからすま京都ホテルを運営、マイナビ、プレスリリース)、2005年からホテルオークラが筆頭株主。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 3階の多目的スペースの朝食、和洋のビュッフェ、おばんざい、湯豆腐、きんぴらごぼう、カレーライス。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel restaurant; self-service buffet.

kyoto_bar_anchor_karasuma_kyoto_hotel.notes: [Hotel bar · Shijo-Karasuma] The calm, spacious basement main bar of Karasuma Kyoto Hotel: a long-established hotel bar for classic and seasonal cocktails, with staff who remember returning guests. About ¥3,000–5,000.

roles: Bar of Karasuma Kyoto Hotel (operator 株式会社京都ホテル)
chef_bio.background: The main bar of Karasuma Kyoto Hotel, run by 株式会社京都ホテル (Mynavi; press release); described as a long-established hotel bar (December 2023 and March 2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 guest, back as a second stop after a first visit with a senior colleague, was surprised to be remembered.
An October 2025 visitor counted cocktails at this classic main bar among the memories of the trip.

kyoto_ricetta_87.gf_detail: Ask. A set course with handmade pasta, pizza and crostini (2025 reviews).
kyoto_ricetta_87.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a set course of seafood, horse meat and beef (2025 reviews).
kyoto_ricetta_87.hours_raw: Lunch from 12:00 (12:00–14:30) and dinner 17:30–22:30 (L.O. 20:30); closing days not fixed; ten guests a day; course only, no seat-only bookings; a credit card must be registered to confirm a booking; call for same-day bookings (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog Japanese original 「サービス料10％」). Cards, e-money (iD, QUICPay) and PayPay (Tabelog). 10 seats — a counter of 6 and a table of 4 in a tatami machiya; shoes off (Tabelog). 2 min from Karasuma-Oike (Tabelog).
kyoto_ricetta_87.notes: [Italian · Karasuma-Oike] Ten seats in a shoes-off machiya where a talkative, warm chef runs one lively counter: inventive Italian courses from top regional produce, homemade pasta and pizza, and an all-inclusive ¥24,200 course with endless pairing. Sister of Rokkaku 887.

chef_bio.background: Opened 11 January 2022 (Tabelog). A chatty, warm chef whose counter sets the mood (2025 reviews); also behind the Kiyamachi standing bar Rokkaku 887 (kyoto_rokkaku_887).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Simplicity is best" — a lot is done without overdoing it (July 2025 review).

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 regular on a fifth visit, once a commute from Tokyo and now from Osaka, makes it a Friday solo night out.
A December 2025 party of three at the counter found the endless pairing generous enough to drink a little too much; the new pizza was a highlight.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリア料理式 ricetta8.7、イタリアン・イノベーティブ、中京区、烏丸御池駅から徒歩2分、昼 12:00〜14:30、夜 17:30〜22:30 (L.O. 20:30)、不定休、1日10名、コースのみ、予約時にカード登録、サービス料10%、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、10席 (カウンター6、テーブル4)、町家で靴を脱ぐ、2022年1月11日オープン。口コミ (2025年、英語): 話好きで温かい料理人、全国の食材、自家製パスタとピザ、24,200円のオールインクルーシブのコース (2025年12月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Card registration needed to book; shoes off (Tabelog).

kyoto_the_kotora_shoten.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fish cakes (hanpen, satsuma-age), agedashi tofu, mentaiko and beer are staples of the menu (2026 reviews).
kyoto_the_kotora_shoten.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood-and-chicken menu — clams, firefly squid, river fish from the tank, fish cakes, kashiwa chicken (2026 reviews).
kyoto_the_kotora_shoten.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 12:00–15:00, last order about 14:30; closed Sunday (Tabelog; April 2026). Lunchtime drinking only. No reservations; a queue forms at opening and later arrivals are often turned away (May–July 2026); the shop asks people to line up only from ten minutes before opening and not to wait nearby (October 2026). Cash only (Tabelog; June 2026). Five small tables, with a charcoal shichirin on each (February and June 2026). On Niomon-dori near Kawabata, about ten minutes from Keihan Sanjo (April 2026).
kyoto_the_kotora_shoten.notes: [Daytime izakaya · Niomon-dori] A lunch-only drinking spot in a former fish shop, run by the Akagakiya group: seafood and river fish from the tank, part-cooked and finished on a charcoal shichirin at your table, with beer poured to taste — bitter, smooth or fizzy. Drinks ¥700, most dishes ¥300–500. Five tables, no reservations: queue from ten minutes before 12:00. Cash only; closed Sunday. Sister concept of Akagakiya (listed separately).

roles: Run by a couple, with one person in the kitchen (June 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a daytime izakaya run by the Kyoto izakaya Akagakiya (Akagakiya group) in a former fish shop near the main shop (February, April and September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Seafood and river fish on the shichirin; beer poured to taste.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 return visitor watched iwana and moroko netted from the tank beside the table, with rakugo playing on a cassette deck, and grilled firefly squid both raw and on the shichirin.
An April 2026 diner arriving at 14:00 paid ¥1,300 for sake, agedashi tofu and moroko, and had to ask twice whether the bill was right.
An October 2026 group learned the house rule: line up only ten minutes before opening, and wait out of sight until then — most people wait at a nearby temple.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・立ち飲み、左京区大菊町102、月〜土12:00〜15:00、日曜休み、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年10月、英語): 赤垣屋 (Akagakiya) の系列の昼飲みの店、元魚屋の建物、予約不可、開店時に行列、並ぶのは開店10分前から、各テーブルに七輪、お通しのはんぺんやさつま揚げ、赤貝、ホタルイカ、水槽のいわなとモロコ、活けの鮎、いさき、貝、ビワマス、かしわ、厚揚げ、いわし、品数を言えばおまかせ、ドリンクは一律700円、料理はほぼ300〜500円、ビールは苦め・まろやか・強炭酸を選べる、カセットで落語、夫婦で営む、現金のみ、L.O.14:30ごろ、京阪三条から徒歩約10分。

cultural_comfort.note: Queue only from 11:50 — the shop asks people not to wait outside earlier. Bring cash. Say how many dishes you want and the kitchen chooses. No English evidence found.

kyoto_meton_cafe.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: house-baked madeleines, canelés, cream puffs, sablés, galette with a whole-grain crust, rum-currant cake (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_meton_cafe.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pudding, cream puffs, panna cotta, prosciutto, madeleines (2025–26 reviews); no vegan item sourced.
kyoto_meton_cafe.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu, Sat, Sun 14:00–21:00; closed Wednesday and Friday; may change — the shop posts changes on Instagram (Tabelog; November 2025). One person runs it, so orders take time — about 20 minutes for a latte on a busy day (December 2025). Order first; cash only (Tabelog; November 2025). A window counter, a stand and one table for four; tables may be shared when full (April 2025, March 2026). Photos of your own table only (April 2025). Second floor of the building that houses ザコトラ商店, up steep stairs, marked by a small red sign, on Niomon-dori about four minutes from Sanjo Keihan (April, October and November 2025).
kyoto_meton_cafe.notes: [Café & sweets · Niomon-dori] A tiny upstairs café-bar near Sanjo Keihan, above ザコトラ商店, where one person bakes and serves: firm caramel pudding, canelés, cream puffs, madeleines with prosciutto, seasonal galettes, coffee from STYLE COFFEE, and wine with small plates into the evening. 14:00–21:00; closed Wednesday and Friday. Cash only; expect to wait.

roles: Owner (named in one review as Yamashita), who runs the shop alone (April and November 2025)
chef_bio.background: Per reviews: opened in February 2025 by an owner from the apparel trade who later worked at Walkon (now closed) and NISHITOMIYA (April and November 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per an August 2025 review: baked goods made with aluminium-free baking powder.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 pair shared a canelé, strawberry panna cotta and a cream puff with two drinks for ¥2,750, and called it a favourite opening of the year.
An April 2025 diner had madeleines — made with fennel — with prosciutto, and plans to come back for something sweet.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、左京区大菊町102 ザコトラ商店2F、月火木土日14:00〜21:00、水・金曜休み、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、2025年2月24日オープン。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年5月、英語): 仁王門通、京阪三条から徒歩約4分、赤い小さな看板、急な階段、一人で営む、先に注文、現金のみ、撮影は自分の席だけ、STYLE COFFEE の豆、プリン600円、ホットコーヒー600円、カフェラテ650円、カヌレ、いちごのパンナコッタ、シュークリーム、金柑のガレット、ヴィジタンディーヌ、フェンネル入りのマドレーヌと生ハム、ラムとカラントのケーキとバニラアイス、ワインとウフマヨ、アルミフリーのベーキングパウダー、店主は以前アパレルの仕事、Walkon (閉店) と NISHITOMIYA で経験。

cultural_comfort.note: Order and pay in cash first; one person runs the shop, so allow time. Photograph only your own table. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through May 2026.

kyoto_kodaiji_hashiba.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the yuba sets include nama-fu (wheat gluten) dengaku, tempura, yuba gratin and soy-based dashi dishes (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kodaiji_hashiba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi throughout, shrimp tempura, shirasu rice, a dairy gratin (2025–26 reviews). The yuba itself is made from additive-free domestic soy milk (August 2026), but no vegan set is sourced.
kyoto_kodaiji_hashiba.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30); during the spring, summer and autumn (23 October–13 December) illuminations also 17:00–19:30 (last order); may close for temple events (Tabelog). "サービス料なし、チャージ料なし" — no service or cover charge (Tabelog). No cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 48 seats, all at tables (Tabelog). Reservations taken (November 2025); a 20-minute wait at a March 2026 lunch. English menu and an English-speaking server (January and May 2026). Second floor above a gallery, inside the Kodaiji temple precinct beside the Sho Art Museum, with window views of the Yasaka pagoda (March, May and November 2025–26).
kyoto_kodaiji_hashiba.notes: [Yuba · Kodaiji] A second-floor dining room in the Kodaiji temple precinct, looking out to the Yasaka pagoda, serving lunch sets of house-made yuba from additive-free soy milk: three fresh yuba, a bubbling yuba gratin, the creamy yuba rice bowl, nama-fu dengaku, tempura or yudofu. Lunch daily; evenings during the temple illuminations. Cash only; English menu.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: a yuba restaurant on the second floor of 京洛市 ねね, inside the Kodaiji temple precinct next to the Sho Art Museum, making its yuba from additive-free domestic soy milk (August 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: House-made fresh yuba; yuba gratin; creamy yuba rice bowl.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 diner found the server fluent in English and explaining each dish in detail, and wanted a second yuba gratin.
A May 2026 visitor half-expected a tourist trap from the English menu, then found long windows onto the early-summer green and the five-storey pagoda, and a yuba gozen judged excellent value.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京料理・天ぷら・豆腐料理、東山区高台寺下河原町530 京洛市 ねね 2F、毎日11:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)、春・夏・秋 (10月23日〜12月13日) のライトアップ期間は17:00〜19:30 (L.O.) も、寺の行事で臨時休業あり、サービス料なし、チャージ料なし、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、48席 (すべてテーブル)。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年8月、英語): 高台寺の境内、Sho Art Museum の隣、1階はギャラリー、窓から八坂の塔、自家製の京湯葉膳、ゆば3種 (わさび・ごま・しょうが)、ゆばグラタン、名物のとろとろのゆばのご飯、生麩田楽、白味噌の味噌汁、海老と野菜の天ぷら膳、ゆばとしらすのご飯、自家製の山椒昆布、湯豆腐、無添加の国産大豆の豆乳、英語のメニュー、英語の話せるスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (May 2026) and an English-speaking server (January 2026). Bring cash. Book ahead in the autumn leaves season.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_roppakuya_kado.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pizza, pasta, tempura, gratin, clam chowder in a pastry shell (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_roppakuya_kado.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat, fish and cheese menu; even the vegetable dishes come with cheese, butter or miso butter (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_roppakuya_kado.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:30); closed Monday, but open on a Monday before a holiday (Tabelog). Reservations for seats only — order on the night (Tabelog); booking advised on weekends (January 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 30 seats over three floors: a four-seat counter on the ground floor, tables on the second (private hire up to 22), private sunken-kotatsu rooms on the third (Tabelog; March and July 2026). Down a back alley in Kannondo-cho off Muromachi, about five minutes from Hankyu Karasuma, next door to くぐり鍋 六白屋, which shares the Roppakuya name (Tabelog; July 2026).
kyoto_roppakuya_kado.notes: [Vegetable izakaya & wine · Shijo-Muromachi] A three-storey back-alley house off Muromachi serving Kyoto vegetables Western-style with wine: Kyoto-vegetable pizza, Manganji peppers from the oven, corn and fig tempura, zucchini steak, pastry-topped clam chowder, pasta and Roppaku black pork. Four-seat counter downstairs, private rooms above. Open to midnight; closed Monday. Sister of くぐり鍋 六白屋 next door.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: a Western-style izakaya in Kannondo-cho off Muromachi, next door to くぐり鍋 六白屋 and using the same Roppaku black pork (February 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto vegetables in Western-style dishes; Kyoto-vegetable pizza.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 pair took the four-seat ground-floor counter and were most surprised by the water-eggplant sashimi and the zucchini steak.
A July 2026 diner came in during Gion Matsuri and ordered fig tempura, a whole onion stewed for two days in miso butter, and sautéed apples with house-made ice cream.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋、中京区室町新町の間四条上ル観音堂町453-1、火〜日17:00〜24:00 (L.O.23:30)、月曜休み (祝日の前日は営業)、席のみの予約、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、30席 (宴会35名)。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年7月、英語): 隣はくぐり鍋 六白屋、Roppaku 黒豚のボロネーゼ、飲み放題のコース5,500円、京野菜のピザ1,250円、亀岡牛のユッケ風1,500円、アボカドのタルタル680円、万願寺とうがらしのオーブン焼き、白とうもろこしの天ぷら、水なすの刺身、ズッキーニのステーキ680円、いちじくの天ぷら700円、玉ねぎ丸ごとの味噌バター煮590円、りんごのソテーと自家製アイス590円、パイ包みのクラムチャウダー、1階はカウンター4席、2階はテーブル (貸切22名)、3階は掘りごたつの個室、阪急烏丸駅から徒歩約5分。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a seat, then order on the night; ask for the ground-floor counter for two. No English evidence found.

kyoto_bar_keller.gf_detail: Ask. A whisky bar with some food; no dish or gluten information in the sources (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_bar_keller.vegan_detail: Ask. Whisky, Calvados and fresh-fruit non-alcoholic cocktails; the food is not described (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_bar_keller.hours_raw: MEMBERS ONLY: a members-only bar — non-members can enter only when accompanied by a member (Tabelog remark); a reviewer describes entry by introduction only (October 2025). Tabelog gives no business hours, so none are listed; reviewers describe evening and late-night visits (April 2025). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Smoking allowed; cigars (Tabelog; May 2023). Private rooms (Tabelog). About ¥5,000–6,000 a head (Tabelog). Vals Building 1F at Kiyamachi-Nijo, by the Kamo River, in the same building as Bar K6; 5–7 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_bar_keller.notes: [Whisky bar · Kiyamachi-Nijo — members only] The K6 family’s members-only whisky cellar: bottle chandeliers, rare malts, small casks and a house blend ageing in a barrel behind glass, plus fresh-fruit mocktails. Non-members must come with a member. Smoking and cigars allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a members-only whisky bar run by Nishida, the bar figure behind K6 (established 1994), in the same Vals Building as K6 and the wine bar Cave de K (February 2023; June 2026). Keller means cellar in German (June 2026). A long-time member addresses the master as Tani (January 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Rare whisky; house blend from the cask.

anecdotes.text: A March 2024 visitor, brought by a globe-trotting friend who is a member, peered through an aquarium-like window at the barrel holding the bar’s own blend.
A non-drinker at the April 2026 anniversary had four fresh-fruit mocktails: kumquat, strawberry, hyuganatsu and dekopon.
An October 2025 regular likened the introduction-only rule to a tea house where you cannot pay without an account.

kyoto_yakiniku_shoei.gf_detail: Ask. Salted tongue and plain cuts may suit, but marinades, sauces and cold noodles involve soy or wheat (2026 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_yakiniku_shoei.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku and offal house (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_shoei.hours_raw: Tuesday–Friday 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00; Monday and Saturday 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); Sunday and holidays 17:00–22:30 (last order 22:00); closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; seat-only bookings carry a minimum spend of ¥7,000 per table (Tabelog). A booked table can end up at the counter (October 2026). Cards per Tabelog (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), but a July 2026 diner saw a “no cards” sign at lunch — check. 52 seats incl. counter, tatami, sunken kotatsu and couple seats; private rooms for 6–10; non-smoking inside, ashtray at the door; shoes off (Tabelog; July 2026). 5 min walk from Shijo, Karasuma or Karasuma-Oike Stn.
kyoto_yakiniku_shoei.notes: [Yakiniku · Shinmachi-Rokkaku] A roomy shoes-off yakiniku house of A5 wagyu with kotatsu and private rooms: generous evening courses of thick tongue and skirt, and a famous ¥1,300 weekday lunch with bottomless beef and rice. ¥7,000-per-table minimum for seat-only bookings.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a yakiniku and Korean restaurant near the Shijo-Karasuma office district serving A5 kuroge wagyu, with private rooms for company gatherings. Reviewers in 2026 praise generous portions, attentive staff and very quick refills.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 solo diner aimed for three refills of the ¥1,300 beef set, which arrived in under two minutes.
An October 2026 group found the course generous at a time when many places serve small portions, singling out the skirt and ribeye.
An October 2026 guest who came for the kotatsu after seeing it on YouTube was seated at the counter despite booking a table.

cultural_comfort.note: Shoes off; ¥7,000-per-table minimum for seat-only bookings; check card use at lunch.

kyoto_gohanya_karasuma_oike.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi may suit, but oden, dengaku, saba miso and kasu-jiru use soy or miso, and nama-fu is wheat gluten (2025–2026 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_gohanya_karasuma_oike.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seasonal fish, game meat and dashi-based oden (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gohanya_karasuma_oike.hours_raw: Monday 17:30–22:15; Tuesday–Saturday and holidays 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:15); closed Sunday — when Sunday and Monday are a holiday weekend, open Sunday and closed Monday (Tabelog). Dinner only now; lunch served during the pandemic has stopped (September 2026). Rice is cooked to be ready around 19:30 (February 2026). Reservations accepted and advised — “full house” on Fridays (Tabelog; September 2026). Cards (Master, JCB, AMEX); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 38 seats: an eight-seat counter, a 2F private room and sunken kotatsu for 9; completely non-smoking (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). 2 min walk from Karasuma-Oike Stn. Since 1990 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gohanya_karasuma_oike.notes: [Izakaya · Karasuma-Oike] A house-like Kyoto izakaya open since 1990: rich oden, nama-fu dengaku, fatty buri sashimi and yuzu-scented saba miso, with sake picked by the staff, and rice or kasu-jiru to finish. Fills up on Fridays — book. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and the official site: ごはんや., a single izakaya near Karasuma-Oike, open since 1990, built around seasonal fish, vegetables and game. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a homely house-like room, a counter where staff chat and help choose sake, and a comforting smell of rice.
chef_bio.philosophy: Not just a diner or a bar — an izakaya for seasonal fish, vegetables and game with drinks to match (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner who had lunch here during the pandemic came back for dinner and saw the “full house” sign go up on a Friday.
A February 2026 guest arriving at 5:30 p.m. was told the rice would only be ready around 7:30.
A January–February 2025 regular always ends with the kasu-jiru, but prefers the counter for chatting with staff.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・ダイニングバー・鶏料理、中京区両替町通御池下る西側、烏丸御池駅から徒歩2分、月 17:30〜22:15、火〜土・祝日 17:30〜23:00 (L.O.22:15)、日曜休み (日月が連休の場合は日曜営業・月曜休み)、予約可、カード (Master・JCB・AMEX) 可、電子マネー・QR 不可、38席、2階の個室と掘りごたつ (9名)、完全禁煙、紹介文 (英訳): 旬の魚・野菜・ジビエの居酒屋、1990年から。公式サイト: 「京都烏丸の居酒屋「ごはんや.」」、中京区両替町通御池下る柿本町404-6。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年9月、英語): 家のような外観、ごはんの香り、おでん (大根、赤こんにゃく)、生麩田楽、焼き生麩、ぶりとろの刺身、刺身の盛り合わせ、柚子の香る鯖の味噌焼き、ポテトサラダ、ナポリタンの春巻き、島らっきょうとふき味噌、親子丼、しめの粕汁、升で出す日本酒、昼はやめて夜のみ (2026年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book on Fridays; counter for solo diners; non-smoking.

kyoto_oyakoya_shinmachi.gf_detail: Not GF for most dishes: tempura, kara-age and katsu are fried in wheat batter, and set meals come with soy-seasoned sides (2023–2026 reviews). Sashimi may suit — ask.
kyoto_oyakoya_shinmachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, chicken and dashi-based set meals (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_oyakoya_shinmachi.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 18:00–21:30; closed Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reviewers also describe a popular weekday lunch of daily set meals, busy after noon (August 2023–May 2026) — Tabelog does not list lunch hours, so lunch is not in the hours. Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No e-money (Tabelog). 6–7 counter seats and 6 raised tatami seats (April 2025). Smoking allowed, at night especially (Tabelog; January 2023). English menu (Tabelog). On Shinmachi-dori just north of Matsubara, with lanterns advertising tempura (May 2026); 8 min walk from Gojo Stn.
kyoto_oyakoya_shinmachi.notes: [Kappo izakaya · Shinmachi-Matsubara] A small, cheerful counter of regulars: a bargain weekday lunch of daily sets — crisp tempura, fish with kara-age or dashimaki for about ¥1,000 — and relaxed evenings of home-style dishes and hot pots. Smoking allowed. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a cosy izakaya on Shinmachi-dori whose owner runs the evening alone, with a charming personality that keeps regulars lingering (January 2023; September 2024); weekday lunches of set meals draw crowds (2023–2026).

anecdotes.text: A January 2023 solo diner found no prices posted at night and a cheerfully tipsy owner; side dishes, a stew, a hot pot and drinks came to ¥3,000.
An April 2025 lunch guest praised a ¥900 tempura set of sardine, yellowtail and shrimp, light and not greasy.
A May 2026 diner fitted in lunch before an after-school duty supervising local children.

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; smoking allowed; lunch busy after noon.

kyoto_ueyanagi_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kaiseki with dashi, vinegar dressings and hand-made soba (buckwheat; ask whether it is pure buckwheat); no gluten information is published (official site).
kyoto_ueyanagi_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kaiseki of fish, eel, suppon and chicken (official site).
kyoto_ueyanagi_gion.hours_raw: 12:00–22:30 (last order 22:00); closed Sunday (official site). Tabelog gives 12:00–14:00 and 17:30–22:30 (last order 21:30) Monday–Saturday. Service 10% and tax 10% on top of menu prices (official site; Tabelog lists 10% at night). Cards accepted; no e-money (Tabelog). 17 seats with private rooms for 2–8; smoking allowed (Tabelog). On the third floor above the ochaya まん, reached by a stone path and a lift; interior by the designer 森田恭通; maiko and geiko can entertain in the zashiki (official site). Gion-machi Kitagawa, about 5 minutes from Yasaka Shrine (official site; Tabelog).
kyoto_ueyanagi_gion.notes: [Kaiseki · Gion north of Shijo, above an ochaya] A designer kaiseki room on the third floor of a Gion ochaya building, where a chef trained at a classic Kyoto kaiseki house cooks Kyoto courses with playful touches — bright soups, hand-cut soba — and maiko can join the party. Mini kaiseki from ¥8,000; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Born in Kyoto, the son of a sushi shop; trained for many years at the old Kyoto kaiseki house 高台寺土井; became head chef of うゑ柳 in 2006 through a chance connection with the okami, and works with two young apprentices (official site). The restaurant sits on the third floor above the ochaya まん (official site).
chef_bio.philosophy: To cook for every guest as for a loved one or family; the guest, not the chef, is the star (official site).

anecdotes.text: An October 2023 guest called it the most luxurious meal of a lifetime, with Akita matsutake and Nagasaki beef.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都祇園 うゑ柳、モダンなビルの1・2階が「お茶屋 まん」、3階が「うゑ柳」、石畳のアプローチとエレベーター、インテリアデザイナー森田恭通氏の設計、舞妓・芸妓のおもてなし、12:00〜22:30 (L.O.22:00)、日曜定休、京都市東山区祇園町北側347、伝統を受け継いだ本格的な京料理と独創的な料理、料理長は寿司店の息子として京都に生まれ、高台寺土井で長年修行、2006年にうゑ柳の料理長、2人の若い弟子、ミニ会席8,000円から (先附、向附、焼八寸、地鶏叩きの出汁茶漬け、自家製チーズケーキなど)、夜のおまかせ25,000円・30,000円、特別コース30,000円から、すっぽん25,000円から、はも20,000円から、天然ふぐ25,000円から、サービス料10%・消費税10%別、色鮮やかなスープ、手挽きのそば粉の手打ちそば、お茶屋はんのチーズケーキ「無垢」、お知らせ (2025年9月 祇園をどり)。食べログ: うゑ柳、日本料理・海鮮、月〜土 12:00〜14:00、17:30〜22:30 (L.O.21:30)、夜はサービス料10%、カード可、電子マネー不可、17席、個室 (2〜8名)、喫煙可。口コミ (2007〜2025年、英語): 秋田の松茸、長崎の牛肉 (2023年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; 10% service and tax extra; smoking allowed.

kyoto_bar_next_kawaramachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Fresh-fruit cocktails and spirits; snacks such as raisin butter contain dairy (reviews).

Ground floor of a building in the second lane north of Sanjo, east of Kawaramachi (official site).
kyoto_bar_next_kawaramachi.notes: [Bar · Kawaramachi north of Sanjo, fruit cocktails and old whisky] A relaxed grown-up bar off Kawaramachi with seasonal fresh-fruit cocktails (fig, grape) and a shelf of 1980s-era whisky bottles at fair prices. English menu; ¥300 charge; smoking allowed; open nightly to midnight.

chef_bio.background: A Kawaramachi bar reviewed since 2013 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe a gentlemanly master, an English-speaking staff member and a cosy, adult atmosphere.

anecdotes.text: A September 2023 guest liked the fresh fig cocktail enough to follow it with a fresh grape one.
A December 2025 visitor discovered whiskies that taste of brandy and others of iodine.

kyoto_gion_shoan_oden.gf_detail: Ask. Oden and shabu-shabu in a kombu-and-katsuobushi dashi; the sets end with a fried banana-fu doughnut, and the vegan course’s nama-fu contains wheat (official site).
kyoto_gion_shoan_oden.vegan_detail: Some vegan options: a plant-based Kyoto course, “Ohara” (¥6,800), of yuba, nama-fu and seasonal Kyoto vegetables with no animal ingredients — book by noon on the day (official site). The regular oden dashi uses katsuobushi.
kyoto_gion_shoan_oden.hours_raw: Lunch from 11:30 by reservation only; dinner 17:00–22:00; irregular closing days (official site). Tabelog lists 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00 daily. A breakfast set of oden and Hida beef is also offered (official site). Booking through TableCheck on the official site includes a free welcome drink (official site). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX); no e-money or QR; charges included in course prices (Tabelog). 12 seats: an 8-seat counter and a table for 4; non-smoking; English menu (Tabelog; official site). Ground floor of a building tucked away north of Shijo in Gion (Tabelog; 2023 reviews).
kyoto_gion_shoan_oden.notes: [Oden & wagyu · Gion north of Shijo, a hidden counter] A twelve-seat Gion hideaway where the okami serves Kyoto-style oden and Hida beef shabu-shabu in the same long-simmered dashi, after a colourful obanzai platter. Sets from ¥5,800, plus a plant-based course (¥6,800, book by noon). English menu.

chef_bio.background: A Gion hideaway where the okami welcomes guests with seasonal food (official site). Reviewers (2023–2025) describe a warm, wood-scented room, an owner who reheats the oden at the counter, and at times a single person running the whole service.
chef_bio.philosophy: A long-loved oden dashi of carefully chosen kombu and katsuobushi, used to bring out wagyu in shabu-shabu (official site).

anecdotes.text: An April 2023 couple were won over by the big platter of seasonal side dishes before the oden.
A May 2025 guest had the ¥8,800 set ending with a fried banana doughnut and coffee.
An August 2025 diner enjoyed the oden reheated at the counter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 祇園匠庵 京風おでんと和牛、ヴィーガン京料理コース「大原」6,800円 (湯葉・生麩・旬の京野菜、動物性食材を使わない、当日12時までに要予約、生麩に小麦を使用)、特選飛騨牛ひとりしゃぶしゃぶ・焼きしゃぶとおでんセット14,800円、飛騨牛ひとりしゃぶしゃぶ・焼きしゃぶとおでんセット12,800円、飛騨牛焼きしゃぶとおでんセット8,800円、飛騨牛しゃぶしゃぶとおでんセット8,800円、生麩・豆腐・京野菜しゃぶしゃぶとおでんセット8,800円、京風おでんセット5,800円 (大皿盛り、ごはんと香の物、バナナ麩の揚げドーナツアイス添え、京風オーガニック珈琲か日本茶付き)、昆布と鰹節の出汁、女将のおもてなし、朝食御膳 (おでんと飛騨牛)、公式予約 (TableCheck) で乾杯ドリンク1杯サービス、英語メニュー、昼11:30〜 (完全予約制)、夜17:00〜22:00、不定休。食べログ: 祇園 匠庵、おでん・日本料理、京都市東山区祇園町北側347-87 彩和ビル1F、11:30〜15:00、17:00〜22:00、カード可、電子マネー・QR決済不可、チャージはコース料金に含む、12席 (カウンター8、4人卓)、禁煙。口コミ (2020〜2025年、英語): 大皿のおばんざい、おでん、締めのラーメン、目の前で温め直すおでん、ひとりで切り盛り、気さくな店主。
